registration.title: Sharpening and the draw boost searched together
registration.what: The sharpening power and the two draw-boost numbers chosen jointly (power 1.08, boost 1.09, fade 1.5).
registration.why: The two changes overlap: sharpening already takes weight off the draw.
registration.how: A joint search on 2023/24, scored once on the other periods.
registration.hypothesis: The two together improve the result probabilities by more than either alone.

expected.evidence: The pattern was found on most of the test period before the test (DESIGN.md says so), so the test confirms rather than discovers; the 2021 to 2023 holdout had not been looked at.

registration.success_criteria: The standing bar: result log loss better by at least 0.002 on held-out matches, with the interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing and the same direction in each season. A second, weaker bar for the ends: the ends gap down by a quarter, log loss no worse, and half the competitions no worse.

events.label: Test, July 2024 onwards
events.meaningful: The same size as sharpening alone: with the ends stretched the draw boost wants to stay near where it is.
